text.p: Discarded Australia test batsman Ricky Ponting has led Tasmania's bid to avoid the follow-on in their Sheffield Shield match against South Australia.
Ponting joined with Daniel Marsh to steer Tasmania to 161 for five, still 76 runs short of their intitial target, during the morning session on the third day at Bellerive Oval,
Ponting, who was overlooked for Australia's tour to South Africa, remained on 82 not out alongside Marsh, who was 18 not out.
Tasmania resumed on 136 for five in reply to South Australia's first innings 387.
Tasmania will move into second place on the Sheffield Shield table behind Western Australia with an outright victory in Hobart against the bottom side.
